title: Apps Running End To End
description: After the heavy monorepo restructure, get all apps running end to end: fix playground catalog path, electron-forge bun.lock discovery, verify each bun run dev:* boots.

Retargeted stale ⚡️implementations path aliases to Shape-V2 📦️packages glue entries (framework-core, framework-os-core, infinite renderers, host/ui scripts, session/brand imports). Verified: bun run dev:procedural:3d serves HTTP 200; 10 priority playground apps smoke OK; compose-desktop launches Electron. Remaining known gap: @semio-tech/animate-present-core is still missing for mit-bestand presentation.
